Name: (SVE) Victor Anime Portrait ( OhoDavi-Inspired )
Author: bunzbunzMODS
Description:
Portrait for Victor from the SVE Mod. For this to work, simply download it and replace the already existing Victor portrait in the Stardew Valley Expansion Mod under assets/character files/portraits/Victor. I have yet to do OhoDavi Inspired portraits for the remaining SVE characters that haven't been done, as well as planning on characters from the East Scarp Mod. When I do, I will upload them here as well.

Thank you!

Downloads.Description: Unzip the downloaded file to reveal Victor.png and replace the existing Victor.png file in "Stardew Valley Expanded Mod" / assets / Character Files / Portraits / Victor.
Victor's beach portrait ONLY. Unzip the PNG and add to Victor's portraits file alongside his main portrait.
